description:
The Juris-M library contains several pre-loaded legal references. Your task is to edit the metadata of the 'Tinker v. Des Moines Independent Community School District' case entry.

Specifically, you need to make the following two changes:

1. Change the 'Date Decided' field from '1969' to 'February 24, 1969'
2. Add 'Docket No. 21' to the 'Extra' field (currently empty)

To do this, click on the Tinker case in the items list, then edit the fields in the right-hand Info pane. You may need to scroll down in the Info pane to find the Extra field.
